title: Notre Dame will wear a Packers-inspired uniform for Week 1 game at Lambeau Field

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Notre Dame will wear a Packers-inspired uniform for Week 1 game at Lambeau Field
sources.description: Decades before football became Nikefied, with teams having nearly as many different uniforms as they have games, it was rare — and thus special — when a team showed up for a game with a different look.
